# Google Home Max

Play audio and control playback or volume on Google Home Max through Muse Home Link, using its available Cast receiver and the shared Google Cast skill; this does not provide general auxiliary-input control. Audio only, and the whole Cast procedure lives in the companion gadget-google-cast skill, referenced from this profile as ../gadget-google-cast/SKILL.md.
